statements: priceCart in src/price.mjs keeps growing. Move its discounts into an ordered list exported as rules from src/rules.mjs, each rule { name, apply(cart, subtotal, discount) } returning the new discount, and have priceCart walk that list.
Then add one rule named loyalty: a cart with years of 3 or more gets a further 2% of the subtotal, rounded down, on top of every other discount.
Apart from that new rule, every answer priceCart gives today stays exactly the same. Other teams depend on it, including on the applied list.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Split the discounts in priceCart into a rule list and add the loyalty rule, as the numbered statements describe. Nothing else may change. Follow the conventions already in the code.
